title: Treatise on Ironbound Heads and Armor Breaking
summary: Teaches how heavy iron-banded flail heads numb and break armored opponents by shock more than by piercing.

title: The Qi-Driven Flail Canon
summary: Shows how a Xiantian qi field fed into chain and head adds weight speed and recall to every swing.

title: Advanced Studies in Chain Entanglement
summary: Develops snaring wrapping and stripping of weapons and limbs with the flail chain well beyond a simple loop.

title: Book of the Unbroken Orbit
summary: Trains a never-ending circling of the head that works as both attack and guard and sweeps the surrounding ground.

title: Twin-Head Flail Reading of the Basin Courts
summary: Teaches the paired flails of the dual-track tradition where two heads move as mirror images and cover each other.

title: Hawk-Stoop Flail and the Falling Head
summary: Trains diving overhead swings in the manner of a hawk stooping from the azure sky with a guard like folded wings.

title: River-Ford Flail Lessons in Paired Swing
summary: Applies the images of river current ford and eddy to alternating paired swings of the flail head.

title: Wind-Sworn Flail Lessons of the Plateau
summary: Teaches wind-sworn students to fight on open plateau ground using the gust as part of each swing.

title: Bearing of the Chain Under Open Sky
summary: Trains the holding of one fixed bearing against a moving foe on exposed ground with an oath-held guard.

title: Gale Flail Notes on the Long Swing
summary: Builds the widest swing the chain allows with hips and wind driving it and a squall guard to cover its recovery.
